# Running Async Code with Tokio
Async code requires an asynchronous executor runtime. Tokio is the de facto industry standard:

```rust
// Using tokio::main macro
// #[tokio::main]
// async fn main() {
//     let result = fetch_remote().await;
//     println!("Result: {}", result);
// }
```
